name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three HTTPS-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, rate limiting, fail2ban, firewall rules, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and service settings, manages log directory permissions, and applies configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its virtual environment and dependencies, provisions the database and user, and runs the application as a systemd service.
